title: Pak-a-Sak Meets Casey's: A New Chapter in the Texas Panhandle
summary: Pak-a-Sak stores across the Texas Panhandle are transitioning to Casey's. Learn what to expect, including store updates, familiar service and fresh food.
body_markdown:
## Welcome to Casey's


We are grateful for the trust Pak-a-Sak guests have placed in their local stores over the years. We look forward to earning that same trust, serving our new neighbors and becoming part of communities across the Texas Panhandle for years to come.


## A familiar stop is beginning a new chapter


Pak-a-Sak has proudly served generations of guests across the Texas Panhandle. Now, its stores and team members are beginning a transition to Casey's, bringing together two companies that share a commitment to quality, community and friendly service.


If you have been a loyal Pak-a-Sak guest, thank you. We know a change like this can bring questions, and we want to make it easy to understand what's ahead. Our goal is simple: to continue serving you while thoughtfully bringing the Casey's experience to our community.


## What Pak-a-Sak guests can expect


- **A transition over time.** Stores will move to Casey's on a rolling basis. During the transition, some locations may close temporarily as teams prepare the store to reopen.
- **The essentials that keep your day moving.** Guests can continue to count on fuel, drinks, snacks and everyday convenience items.
- **A growing Casey's food experience.** As locations are converted, we'll introduce more of the food Casey's is known for, including handmade pizza and a full menu of prepared food options.
- **The same local connection.** We are excited to welcome Pak-a-Sak team members to Casey's and build on the service and community relationships they have established across the region.


## Getting to know Casey's


Casey's began in Iowa in 1968 and has grown by staying focused on what guests need from their neighborhood store: great service, quality food and a commitment to the communities we serve.


Pizza is at the heart of the Casey's food experience. For over 40 years, we've been making our pizzas by hand with dough prepared fresh in store, real mozzarella cheese and generous toppings. From breakfast pizza to specialty favorites and build-your-own options, we look forward to sharing more of the Casey's menu as stores complete their transition.


## Plan your next visit


Store names, hours, services and product availability may change during the transition and vary by location. For the latest information, use the Casey's store locator or visit Caseys.com.


[Find a Casey's store](https://www.caseys.com/general-store) |


[Explore the Casey's menu](https://www.caseys.com/menu) |


[Learn about Casey's Rewards](https://www.caseys.com/rewards)


### We can't wait to welcome you.
